reponse:
On the Nov 12 sync, Martin flagged two things [1]:

1. **Failing webhooks** — Ellen's team was fighting our webhook signature verification, roughly 1 in 20 events failing [1]. Jake took it, Ellen sent failing event IDs [1], and a fix was deployed on sandbox Nov 16 (a re-serialized-body signing bug) [2]. Ellen turned verification back on Nov 17: 300+ events since, all verifying ✅ [2]. Note the fix ships to production in release 2026.47 on Nov 24 [3].

2. **Per-seller payout schedules** — their top ~200 sellers are on net-7 payouts, everyone else net-30, and Quillon only supports one platform-wide schedule; without per-seller schedules Tradewell would be downgrading their best sellers at go-live [1]. Owen said he'd come back with a clear answer from product/engineering by Friday Nov 20 [2]. Martin chased him on Nov 17 saying they need it for seller comms [2], and I don't see Owen's promised answer or any resolution since Nov 18 — so that one is still open.
